title: Reported Speech: Adverbs and Demonstratives — Quiz 129A
content:
## Reported Speech: Adverbs and Demonstratives

Learn how this, that, these, those and time expressions change in reported speech.

### Lesson focus

1. He said, “I have bought this mobile for my mother.”
2. He said that he had bought the mobile for his mother.
3. He said, “I'll do the shopping this week.”
4. He said that he would do the shopping that week.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
